description_en: Adds a base station device with the specified MAC address and automatically attempts to activate it
description_zh: 增加指定MAC地址的基站设备，会自动尝试进行激活
kebab_example: aliyun cloudesl add-ap-device --store-id s-dxsxx0000 --ap-mac 11:22:33:44:55:66 --remark '天猫店的基站设备' --client-token 10 --extra-params example-string --serial-number 180000 --api-version 2020-02-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddApDevice

parameters.help_en: The store ID or custom store ID defined by the merchant
parameters.help_zh: 门店ID或商家自定义门店ID
parameters.name: store_id

parameters.help_en: The MAC address of the base station device. You can call DescribeApDevices to obtain this value
parameters.help_zh: 基站设备的Mac地址，可调用DescribeApDevices获取
parameters.name: ap_mac

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. Ignore this parameter
parameters.name: extra_params

parameters.help_en: The serial number (SN) of the device
parameters.name: serial_number
